system.flavor: Hit a mark from the back of a galloping horse, from a moving cart, or from a boat in a current. Shoot while running across a yard without breaking stride, or lean out of a window and still hit the sign across the street.

body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units before rolling. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
Ignore cover from one low obstacle for this attack; you still need a clear path over or around it.

rider.title: Lock - Targeting
rider.html: After resolving, establish Lock if you ended at least 2 units from your starting space. Otherwise retain any existing Lock.
